messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "avoid situations or activities that may trigger an asthma attack"
set: ["avoid situations or activities that may trigger an asthma attack", "avoid activities that increase risk of bleeding or injury", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until effects are known", "avoid driving or other dangerous activities until effects are known", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until you know how tramadol will affect you", "avoid other drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing", "avoid drinking alcohol or using medicines that contain alcohol", "avoid being near people who are sick or have an infection", "avoid eating foods that are high in fat or cholesterol", "avoid choking or gagging", "lower dose may be an option", "different medicine may be an option", "does not help in these situations", "avoid driving or hazardous activity", "avoid broken or irritated skin", "avoid sunlight or tanning beds"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
